CHAPTER 1
Mara stood by the lighthouse window and watched the storm rise over Blackwater Bay. Iris told her the archives were sealed, but Mara wanted to know why her father had vanished. She was afraid of what the island remembered, yet she walked toward the locked room anyway.

Iris followed her up the stairs. "You always chase the worst answer first," Iris said, but she stayed beside Mara because she loved her like a sister. Together they opened the iron ledger and found a page that named Elias as the last keeper to disappear.

CHAPTER 2
By morning, Mara decided to cross the cliffs and search Elias's abandoned quarters. She hoped the letters would prove he had escaped, but every room felt arranged for mourning. When Iris argued that the sea had already taken him, Mara refused to believe her and pushed deeper into the salt-stained house.

At the desk, Mara found a map marked with warnings and a final note that contradicted everything Iris had been told. Relief turned into anger as Mara realized the island's history had been hidden on purpose.
